info.name: JavaPack Travel Gear Rental API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for JavaPack Travel Gear Rental RESTful API (Express.js, Sequelize ORM, MySQL, JWT Auth, WIB Timezone, and Soft Delete).

Every list endpoint supports pagination (`page`, `limit`) and optional filters (`search`, etc.) that can be toggled in the Params tab.
